title: Takes time to assemble
text: Takes time to assemble. Assembling can be done by one person, but 2 people are better.  It does take a bit of time to get it together, but the product is well made and looks nice.

product_metadata.title: DHP Maddie Upholstered Platform Bed Frame, Grey Linen, Queen
features: Upholstered in premium Gray linen with unique column Detailing on the headboard and footboard
Available in Black and brown faux Leather, and grey linen
Bentwood slat bases allow Air to freely pass beneath your bed, keeping your mattress fresher longer
The bentwood slats adapt to weight exerted to them, provided you with the right amount of support
description: DHP urban-inspired low profile platform bed features unique column detailing on the upholstered headboard. Its clean contemporary lines and low profile frame make it easy to accessorize with any room theme. Upholstered in your choice of black or brown faux leather, or gray linen, the DHP Maddie bed is sure to create a modern look! also available in twin, full and Queen size to accommodate your living space.
